## Content and licensing

- [ ] The change contains no copied rulebook/adventure prose or official artwork, or the pull request identifies the licence and permission for every such asset.
- [ ] Third-party code, fonts, symbols, images, and data have provenance and notices where required.
- [ ] Public database changes preserve creator authorization and book/page references.
- [ ] Private PDFs, scans, SQL backups, local chart exports, secrets, and campaign material are excluded.
